title: Clinton and the ALH 84001 meteorite as slow-drip disclosure

tellings.quote: Like, there was already a meteor meteorite in the '90s that, you know, Clinton came out with ALH 84001

plain: Michels suggests that the government has been letting out the truth about life beyond Earth slowly, a drop at a time, and gives an example from the 1990s: a meteorite known as ALH 84001, linked to Mars, which he says President Bill Clinton "came out with". He offers this himself, as his own framing in a conversation with a guest, without going into what was announced, and if he is right it would mean such announcements are planned steps toward a larger disclosure.
